story.title: Mary Earps frustrates Arsenal as London City Lionesses earn battling draw
story.summary: Arsenal’s fifth draw from five home games in the Women’s Super League left them frustrated once again but this was a wholly different story to the previous four, as they played out an entertaining 1-1 draw with a London City Lionesses side inspired by their goalkeeper Mary Earps.Aston Villa, Birmingham, Manchester United and Crystal Palace all came to this stadium for a point, defending resolutely
